summary: Approved sequence sheets for EP19 capsule blend lot L02 (WA/2011/192): six-month accelerated stability at 40 °C/75% RH against the 25 °C/60% RH reference. An emerging degradant at the warm condition grew between the pulls, and Esmervane revised the capsule moisture barrier before long-term testing. Conclusions stay within the tested interval.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: EP19 capsule blend: six-month accelerated stability

rows: Lot L02 stored at 40 °C/75% RH and at 25 °C/60% RH for six months. Initial analysis followed by pulls at 1, 3 and 6 months; the intermediate condition is 30 °C/65% RH. Assay by HPLC as % label claim; impurities as % area.

Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0086:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. The warm condition showed an emerging degradant that grew over the six months. Esmervane asked for a higher moisture barrier on the capsule before long-term testing started.
Stability results and total impurities chart

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Ref. degradant peak at RRT 0.86 and 1.12 as set in the protocol. Time zero is one initial analysis shared by all storage conditions; repeated initial rows do not represent separate pulls.

sheets.name: Chamber
rows: Stability lot L02 is identified in the workbook title. Chamber assignment, monitoring and any excursions are documented in the chamber log and batch card.

rows: Refer to the approved sequence sheets and batch card for any deviation or repeat history.
